title: On Choking on a crust of dry bread
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：choke　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 choke 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the old man ① choked on a crust of dry bread in silence, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the old man ② chokes on a crust of dry bread twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ choke on a crust of dry bread at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ choked on a crust of dry bread before — a line in the notebook for April 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Choking on a crust of dry bread in silence, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the old man ever ⑥ chokes the narrow drain with leaves twice over before the April rains, nobody in the garden would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ choke the narrow drain with leaves twice over and never speak of it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a second man ⑧ chokes the narrow drain with leaves in silence every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the garden said a word; ⑨ The old man choked on a crust of dry bread again in 1986, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To choke on a crust of dry bread, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, the old man chokes on a crust of dry bread twice over again and the old man must choke on a crust of dry bread in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 噎住（一般过去式 choked on a crust of dry bread：1976 年那位老人头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 噎住（一般现在 chokes on a crust of dry bread：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 噎住（不定式 to choke on a crust of dry bread：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 噎住（过去完成时 had choked on a crust of dry bread：1970 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 噎住（动名词 choking on a crust of dry bread 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 堵塞（chokes the narrow drain with leaves：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真堵塞让落叶堵住那段窄沟）
G. v. 堵塞（choke the narrow drain with leaves：let it 之后的原形，指随它去让落叶堵住那段窄沟）
H. v. 噎住（后段两处：后来的那位老人照例 chokes the narrow drain with leaves，而那位老人在 1986 年又一次 choked on a crust of dry bread）

answers.why: choke 意为“噎住”，1976 年那位老人一言不发地噎住被一块干面包皮噎住，那是园子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 choked。
choke 意为“噎住”，自那以后那位老人来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 chokes。
choke 意为“噎住”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯噎住被一块干面包皮噎住”，此处为不定式 to choke on a crust of dry bread。
choke 意为“噎住”，园艺笔记里 四月 那行字说明早在 1983 年之前就有人噎住过，故用过去完成时 had choked。
choke 意为“噎住”，那位老人说“噎住被一块干面包皮噎住这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 choking on a crust of dry bread 作主语。
choke 意为“堵塞”，叔叔说的是“万一那位老人真堵塞让落叶堵住那段窄沟”，if 从句里用一般现在 chokes the narrow drain with leaves。
choke 意为“堵塞”，老手们的规矩是“随它堵塞让落叶堵住那段窄沟”（let it choke the narrow drain with leaves），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
choke 意为“噎住”，后来的那位老人每个春天都照例堵塞让落叶堵住那段窄沟，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 chokes。
choke 意为“噎住”，那位老人在 1986 年在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地噎住被一块干面包皮噎住，用一般过去式 choked 叙述。
choke 意为“噎住”，结尾那句是母亲 1988 年的话：要噎住被一块干面包皮噎住，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和园子记住的那一件。

answers: In 1976 the old man choked on a crust of dry bread in silence, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
